source:
@@U00391@@
Play upon him now, Spirits,
ring him round with lovely phantom forms,
plunge him into a sea of delusion!
But first a rat’s tooth to shatter this threshold’s magic.
No need to conjure long;
I hear one scampering near who'll hear me soon.
The Lord of Rats, the Lord of Mice,
Master of Frogs and burrowing Lice,
Of Flies and Bedbugs, commands you appear
And gnaw away this oil-dotted smear!
Ah, and here you come hopping, old friend!
That’s the way! And now to work!
A gnaw or two here at the point, and it’s done!
I’m free!
Dream away, 浮士德, till we meet again!

@@U00392@@
(Exit.)

@@U00394@@
(Waking.)

@@U00395@@
Ah!
Have I been duped a second time?
How can such a throng of spirits
vanish into thin air, telling me
it was only a dream,
a lying dream of the Devil,
and that a poodle ran off?

@@U00398@@
A knock? Come in!
Who's bothering me now?
translation:
@@U00391@@
现在就对他下手吧，精灵们，
用可爱的幻影环绕他，
让他陷入幻海！
但首先要用老鼠的牙齿来粉碎这个门槛的魔力。
无需长时间召唤；
我听到有人在附近奔跑，他很快就会听到我的声音。
老鼠之王，老鼠之王，
青蛙和穴居虱子的大师，
苍蝇和臭虫，你出现的命令
把这滴油迹啃掉！
啊，你来了，老朋友！
就是这样！现在开始工作了！
在这里咬一两下，就完成了！
我有空了！
浮士德，梦想远去，直到我们再次相见！

@@U00392@@
（退出。）

@@U00394@@
（醒来。）

@@U00395@@
啊！
难道我又被骗了？
怎能有如此大群的灵气
消失在稀薄的空气中，告诉我
这只是一个梦，
魔鬼的谎言梦，
一只贵宾犬跑掉了？

@@U00398@@
敲门声？进来！
现在谁来烦我？
